question: Which state cabinet has approved the 'Abua Awas Yojna', a housing scheme in October 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jharkhand**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The 'Abua Awas Yojna' is a housing scheme approved by the Jharkhand state cabinet in October 2023.
 
• This scheme aims to provide affordable housing to the economically weaker sections of the state.
 
• The initiative reflects the state government's commitment to improving living conditions and ensuring housing for all.
 
• Under this scheme, beneficiaries will receive financial assistance to construct or renovate their homes.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Jharkhand has been actively working on various welfare schemes to uplift the socio-economic status of its residents.
 
• The state government has also launched several other schemes focusing on education, health, and employment.
 
• The 'Abua Awas Yojna' is part of the broader strategy to ensure sustainable development and inclusive growth in the state.
 
• Monitoring and effective implementation of such schemes are crucial for achieving the desired outcomes and improving the quality of life for the targeted beneficiaries.
